Unit tests for fd_histf alignment, sampling, percentiles, and performance.

# Purpose
This file is a unit test for the `fd_histf` histogram API. It checks object layout with `FD_STATIC_ASSERT`, then verifies `fd_histf_new`, `fd_histf_join`, `fd_histf_leave`, and `fd_histf_delete` for correct construction and teardown of the histogram object. The test also exercises `fd_histf_sample`, bucket boundaries, total sum tracking, bucket count, percentile calculation, and subtraction between histogram snapshots. At the end, it runs a simple timing loop with `fd_rng_uint_roll` to measure sample performance and then exits after all checks pass.
